scope: Initial geographic and authored-export capability estimates. Trees and resources now carry a place-evidence candidate model; the export plan's tree budget and balanced ore/oil top-up stay separate. Not a digital twin of the simulation. Real-connections generation remains opt-in; the public writer still uses template corridors.

promise_levels.promised: The stated capability has relevant native evidence bound to this exact export and test conditions. Never inferred from stock-map ranks, metadata counts or geographic similarity.
promise_levels.likely: The deterministic model found a candidate. Game behavior or simulation stability remains unverified for this export.
promise_levels.not_possible_here: The current export plan lacks this capability under the stated rule. Not a claim that no other generator or human map-maker could provide it.
promise_levels.unknown: Inputs, a model or relevant game observations are missing. Absence of evidence is not a negative result.

ship.limits: Four-connected block-min depth grid with one-cell shore clearance; a component must reach the central 25 tiles and two separated edge points. Bounds are modelling choices, not measured game limits. The existing ship generator can smooth a path outside this corridor; an authored route still needs its own check.

place.scope: Vegetation suitability and recorded resource evidence on the pan-time 271-node (64 m) lattice, central 25 tiles. Not the export's planted tree budget and not its balanced ore/oil top-up.
place.landcover_source: ESA WorldCover 2021 v200, 10 m, CC-BY 4.0, the same document tools/map-factory/landcover.py reads
place.deposit_source: USGS MRDS through tools/map-factory/evidence.py; capability-evidence.js uses the same MRDS query as mapgen.js, without the exporter's MSHA/NETL sources

fidelity.pan_time: WorldCover overview nearest the 64 m lattice, bounded to 262144 pixels per tile, sampled at the same 271 nodes as the depth grid; capture-time terrain screens slope.
fidelity.prepared: The writer's own 1728-square 10 m WorldCover grid sampled at the same 271 nodes; prepared terrain screens slope. Patch coherence and the tree budget stay in the export plan.

limits: Land cover says what a place can host. It is not the exported plan's tree count or resource bytes.
Balanced ore/oil top-ups fill each export to stock shares; they are not place evidence and never count here.
A missing deposit record is not geographic absence: MRDS has worldwide legacy records with a U.S. focus and uneven completeness/currency; MSHA/NETL are exporter-only.
The slope screen uses capture or prepared terrain at 64 m; the writer grades trees at 16 m, so steep small features read flatter here.
Thresholds are candidate levels awaiting game observation, not native constants.

stock_reference.excluded: CO.crp: blank editor terrain system package
stock_reference.quantiles: Linear interpolation at (n-1)*p; bands strictly below p25, inclusive typical, strictly above p75. Descriptive, not quality gates.

wet_central_fraction.name: Wet share of the central 25 tiles

terrain_relief_m.name: Terrain relief across the whole map

capabilities.name: Road
capabilities.definition: An authored directed highway/ramp route connects an incoming outside node to a different outside node. Reachable start-tile arrival/departure stubs are a separate requirement, not implied by this route.

promise_levels.promised: Exact-export directed native car paths pass, separately from a legal starting hookup.
promise_levels.not_possible_here: No such route in the current authored graph.
promise_levels.unknown: No authored graph; mapped roads alone are a preliminary candidate.

capabilities.name: Ship
capabilities.definition: A ship-route candidate is supported by an authored edge-to-edge ship route or a broad deep corridor in the initial water plan. Route existence, broad-corridor support, native pathfinding and sustained navigability are separate observations.

promise_levels.promised: Exact package and prepared inputs match all four successful native boundary/midpoint direction controls, under an explicitly matching game/mod/protocol context. This verifies sampled lane paths at opening only; no continuous clearance or sustained/service promise.
promise_levels.likely: An authored edge-to-edge ship route or a candidate initial deep-water corridor exists. A coarse corridor miss cannot veto an authored route; neither is native navigability proof.
promise_levels.not_possible_here: Both the authored route and the broad corridor are absent in the supplied final export plan, under the stated checks. This does not rule out another planner or a narrower route missed by coarsening.
promise_levels.unknown: The planner was explicitly disabled, neither kind of candidate was established and one input is missing, or only a browser estimate is available. Missing evidence is not a negative geographic result.

capabilities.limits: Fixture airport fallbacks in the existing generator are not geographic evidence for arbitrary squares. Terrain clearance at high altitude and service remain unverified.

capabilities.name: Fresh water
capabilities.definition: A reachable clean fresh-water intake can supply the starting population, with enough sustained flow and a sewage outlet that does not contaminate it.

promise_levels.promised: Exact-package sustained native intake and sewage test passes with recorded demand.
promise_levels.likely: A future fitted flow/intake model finds a candidate.
promise_levels.not_possible_here: A complete model rules out the stated water-supply option, not all alternatives.
promise_levels.unknown: Wet pixels alone do not establish clean intake capacity.

capabilities.limits: PL-1078 owns this model/oracle. Groundwater availability is a separate fallback. Historical first-hour failures are not map-fault labels until the player policy passes stock controls.

capabilities.name: Start site
capabilities.definition: A dry legal build site in an unlockable starting tile can join a reachable outside road using geometry the game accepts.

promise_levels.promised: Exact-export native construction and road hookup pass.
promise_levels.likely: A future fitted site-and-hookup model finds a witness.
promise_levels.not_possible_here: Current start policy cannot place a legal connected site.
promise_levels.unknown: Dry terrain or nearby roads alone do not prove a legal start.

capabilities.limits: PL-1078 owns start selection/hookup. Do not use historical 1/8 first-hour rate as exporter accuracy.

capabilities.name: Buildable land
capabilities.definition: Dry initial terrain with local slope below 15 percent in the central 25 tiles, recorded separately from the game's New Game buildable-area percentage and legal building placement.

promise_levels.promised: Exact-export native placement passes for a specified footprint.
promise_levels.not_possible_here: No qualifying samples in a complete final grid.

capabilities.limits: The 15-percent geometric area is not directly comparable to the native metadata bar or a guarantee of a contiguous build site.

capabilities.name: Resources
capabilities.definition: Recorded ore and oil deposits from USGS MRDS, and fertile land from crop, pasture, shrub and wetland cover, reported separately for the central 25 tiles. The exporter's balanced ore/oil top-up is not evidence and is not counted.

promise_levels.promised: Native resource readback matches the exact export; extraction is a separate test. No native receipt exists for this model.
promise_levels.likely: A deposit record lies in the central 25 tiles, or land cover makes fertile land at or above the candidate threshold. The reason names which measure and reports cropland separately from the weighted crop, grass, wetland and shrub suitability.
promise_levels.not_possible_here: A final export plan contains none of the resource grids. Place evidence cannot establish absence, so the live check never returns this level.
promise_levels.unknown: No deposit record is not absence; below-threshold fertile support is not absence; and missing or incomplete land cover cannot rule a resource out.

recorded_ore_central_weight.name: Recorded ore deposits
recorded_ore_central_weight.definition: Sum of recorded ore-deposit weights inside the central 25 tiles: MRDS producers 1.0, past producers 0.8, prospects 0.35, MSHA mines weighted by status. A record, not a measured reserve.

recorded_oil_central_weight.name: Recorded oil deposits
recorded_oil_central_weight.definition: Sum of recorded oil and gas deposit weights inside the central 25 tiles from the same sources. Wells contribute through the exporter's density step, which the live check does not run.

crop_share_of_central_land.name: Crop cover share of central land
crop_share_of_central_land.definition: Share of the central 25 tiles' land nodes mapped as cropland (WorldCover 40). One crop measure, not a resource total.

fertile_land_suitability.name: Fertile land suitability
fertile_land_suitability.definition: Mean over the central 25 tiles' land nodes of WorldCover fertile weight (cropland 1.0, grassland 0.7, wetland 0.3, shrub 0.15) times flatness (full below 6 percent slope, none at 14 percent and above).

landcover_coverage_of_central_land.name: Land-cover coverage
landcover_coverage_of_central_land.definition: Share of the central 25 tiles' land nodes with a WorldCover class. Class 0 is no data, not bare ground.

source_coverage.land cover: ESA WorldCover 2021 v200 at 10 m, global, CC-BY 4.0. The pan-time reader samples a WorldCover overview of the same document, so its shares are a coarse estimate of the 10 m grid the exporter uses.
source_coverage.deposits: USGS MRDS for the square's bounding box: worldwide legacy records with a U.S. focus, uneven completeness and potentially outdated operating information. The exporter also reads MSHA Mines and NETL WELLS; the browser reader does not. Missing records are not evidence of absence.
source_coverage.terrain: Capture heightmap from AWS Terrain Tiles / Terrarium at pan time, the writer's prepared terrain at export. Slope is screened at 64 m.
source_coverage.stock bridge: None claimed. The stock catalogs forest bytes and budgeted tree counts from 104 finished maps; WorldCover tree cover and the planned tree budget are not the same quantity, so no stock band is attached to these measures.

capabilities.fidelity: The live check reads WorldCover cover and one MRDS record query per square. The exporter reads the full 10 m land cover plus MRDS, MSHA and NETL wells. Neither is a final resource plan: balanced mode tops ore and oil up to stock shares after this evidence is recorded.
capabilities.limits: Recorded deposits are public records, not measured reserves, and absence of a record is not absence of a deposit. Balanced ore/oil top-ups, patch shape and extraction gameplay stay in the export plan. Cropland cover is one characteristic of fertile land, not a resource total; below-threshold fertile support stays Unknown.

capabilities.name: Trees
capabilities.definition: Land cover that can host trees, weighted by WorldCover class and screened by the game's own tree-brush slope limit, over the central 25 tiles. Separate from the exporter's planted tree count, which is a 180,000-tree default budget rather than natural abundance.

promise_levels.promised: Exact-export native tree readback and a visual check pass. No native receipt exists for this model.
promise_levels.likely: Land cover in the central 25 tiles supports trees at or above the candidate threshold, with the measured scope named. The export's own tree plan is separate evidence.
promise_levels.not_possible_here: A final export plan contains no trees. The live place-evidence check does not return this level: a 90 percent covered window and a coarse lattice cannot establish absence.
promise_levels.unknown: No land cover, too little of the central land covered, no central land, or support below the candidate threshold. A coarse sample can miss thin cover, so low or zero cover is not a No.

tree_suitability.name: Tree suitability
tree_suitability.definition: Mean over the central 25 tiles' land nodes of WorldCover tree weight (forest and mangrove 1.0, shrub 0.35, wetland 0.15, moss 0.05, grassland 0.03, bare 0.02, cropland 0) times the game tree-brush slope taper (full below 40 percent, none at 50 percent and above).

tree_cover_share_of_central_land.name: Tree cover share of central land
tree_cover_share_of_central_land.definition: Share of the central 25 tiles' land nodes whose WorldCover class is tree cover or mangrove. The game's forest byte is a different measure and is not compared with it.

vegetated_share_of_central_land.name: Vegetated share of central land
vegetated_share_of_central_land.definition: Share of the central 25 tiles' land nodes whose WorldCover class is tree, shrub, grass, crop, wetland, mangrove or moss.

landcover_coverage_of_central_land.name: Land-cover coverage
landcover_coverage_of_central_land.definition: Share of the central 25 tiles' land nodes with a WorldCover class. Class 0 is no data, not bare ground.

source_coverage.land cover: ESA WorldCover 2021 v200 at 10 m, global, CC-BY 4.0. The pan-time reader samples a WorldCover overview of the same document, so its shares are a coarse estimate of the 10 m grid the exporter uses.
source_coverage.deposits: USGS MRDS for the square's bounding box: worldwide legacy records with a U.S. focus, uneven completeness and potentially outdated operating information. The exporter also reads MSHA Mines and NETL WELLS; the browser reader does not. Missing records are not evidence of absence.
source_coverage.terrain: Capture heightmap from AWS Terrain Tiles / Terrarium at pan time, the writer's prepared terrain at export. Slope is screened at 64 m.
source_coverage.stock bridge: None claimed. The stock catalogs forest bytes and budgeted tree counts from 104 finished maps; WorldCover tree cover and the planned tree budget are not the same quantity, so no stock band is attached to these measures.

capabilities.fidelity: The live check reads capture-time terrain and a WorldCover overview at the depth grid's 271 nodes. The exporter reads prepared terrain and the full 10 m land cover at the same nodes. Neither replaces the export plan or a native check.
capabilities.limits: A suitability mean is not a tree count, biome correctness or visual quality. The tree budget (180,000 by default, editor cap 250,000) is a separate export decision, not natural abundance. Below-threshold or zero sampled cover stays Unknown; only the export plan's own empty tree list can say No.

capabilities.name: Stable water
capabilities.definition: Water remains within the flood boundary and retains required mapped reaches during a full native simulation run.

promise_levels.promised: Exact-package full native simulation meets recorded flooding and retention limits.
promise_levels.likely: Not currently available from the existing risk screen.
promise_levels.not_possible_here: A relevant native failure or fitted deterministic impossibility, not merely a warning.
promise_levels.unknown: A clear screen is not a safety certificate.

calibration.limits: Retrospective fitting, not independent agreement. All 50 drying cases are positive; always-warn has the same score. Seven other complete runs are unscored. PL-1072 independent geography is still incomplete; no cleared-square safety claim.

capabilities.limits: Preserve the existing water-risk download gate. This ledger does not lower its thresholds or waive warnings.

required: Native-accepted outside road access and a legal connected start
Pre-baked hydrology with qualified clean intake and sustained water
Honest per-square transport options, with explicit optional rail/ship/air absence
Measured buildable room and accessible gameplay resources
descriptive_not_gates: Central forest cover and total tree count
launch_bar_proposal.limits: Proposal, not launch approval. A higher interest metric is not always better. No hand-picked map fixes.

outside-v1.source_revision_basis: source_sha is the native study's reproduced exporter revision, not a claim about an unresolved original archived-export revision. The immutable frozen prediction file retains its original null revisions and limitations.
outside-v1.scope: Experimental real-connections packages, not the public shipping writer or global geographic feasibility.
outside-v1.method: One scored boundary cell per square/capability: only generic requests at exact outside-end offsets, with matching returned endpoints, qualify as positive witnesses. Named midpoint paths are unscored. No boundary witness is Unknown, not a negative; all failed requests remain diagnostics.
outside-v1.limits: Retrospective projection, not accuracy: some runs predate prediction freeze. There are 11 boundary witnesses and 25 unknown cells: 8 have midpoint-only successes, 4 have non-exhaustive failed probes, 13 have no native requests. 13 model-negative predictions are unrequested; no native negative is validated. No depth/width/grade threshold fitted. 9/9 water-risk screens warn. Launch identity and per-run entry/traffic are unbound, so qualification is withheld. Service, sustained water and global impossibility remain unmeasured.

outside-targeted-v2.method: Targeted v2 follow-up is separate from immutable v1. One cell per package/capability; no pooled repeat votes. Ship candidates require one reciprocal pair with four complete exact-endpoint controls.
outside-targeted-v2.limits: Targeted retrospective follow-up, not accuracy, negative fitting or a blind holdout. Only sampled native lane paths at opening, in this exact loaded-file and plugin context. File identity is not in-memory code attestation; the native collector excludes AssemblyBuilder dynamic assemblies. Three missing DLC-panel assembly errors at every opening are retained, not clean whole-game acceptance. enabled_mod_count=0 does not mean unloaded/no mods: CitiesBridge, the harness and built-ins are loaded. No air v2 controls, actual terminal service, strict no-mods, native depth/width fit, geographic negatives or sustained water. All nine water screens warn; failures and omitted pairs remain Unknown.
